text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 and recover/requalify existing candidate rather than reimplementing from zero. Current BaselineModel.scala still exposes only Constant/Poly/Bs/Ns; build.sbt pins Gale 83cac90a678d1b8a31c590e0c1b8fc8bf3427161. Local candidate 81f6c16e6ab4f2626e74eb2e4f7444a2009714bb exists and is not an ancestor of HEAD. Its 11-file patch contains DctDrift.scala, DctDriftSuite and DctDriftFitSuite, and also explicit event-column-role changes. Review and separate that extra scope instead of treating the entire commit as an automatically approved minimal dependency. Prior candidate test receipts are historical, not proof of current-main behavior. Reconcile current APIs and the exact upstream DCT capability with active Gale/PHRF work; preserve original-grid censoring, cutoff endpoint, intercept and mixed-run contracts and rerun independent fitting equivalence on JVM and JS. This source assessment does not rerun candidate tests or admit/publish the candidate.
